d: She remains one of Indian cinema’s most revered icons, a performer of rare versatility whose beauty never eclipsed her talent. Decades later, actors still look back at Madhubala as a force of nature: effortless on screen, emotionally precise, and impossibly luminous. Behind the glow, however, was a life shaped by control and heartbreak; from her father, Ataullah Khan, to her turbulent relationship with Dilip Kumar, and her troubled marriage to Kishore Kumar. In a life cut tragically short, she still acted in more than 73 films and became the first Indian star to draw the world’s gaze,…
